5g-sa.name: 5G Standalone
5g-sa.description: 5G with its own core (5GC), without an LTE anchor. The mode evaluated in every challenge.

lte.name: Long Term Evolution
lte.description: 4G access technology. The control scenario in Challenge 2.

rat.name: Radio Access Technology
rat.description: Radio access technology (e.g. NR or LTE).

ue.name: User Equipment
ue.description: The user's device: here, the smartphone under test.

5gc.name: 5G Core
5gc.description: The 5G core network. Receives the UE's NAS signalling.

amf.name: Access and Mobility Management Function
amf.description: The 5GC function that handles UE registration, authentication and mobility (the endpoint of NAS messages).

plmn.name: Public Land Mobile Network
plmn.description: An operator's network, identified by MCC/MNC (e.g. 724/085).

mcc-mnc.name: Mobile Country Code / Mobile Network Code
mcc-mnc.description: Country code (724 = Brazil) and operator code. Together they identify the PLMN.

supi.name: Subscription Permanent Identifier
supi.description: The subscriber's permanent 5G identity (equivalent to the IMSI). Never sent in clear.

suci.name: Subscription Concealed Identifier
suci.description: The encrypted SUPI sent in the Registration Request. Its Home-Network-Id (MCC/MNC of the SIM's operator) is in clear, showing which profile the UE used.

msin.name: Mobile Subscription Identification Number
msin.description: The part of the subscriber identifier that follows the MCC/MNC.

guti.name: 5G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier
guti.description: A temporary identity assigned in the Registration Accept, used instead of the SUCI on later accesses.

tac.name: Tracking Area Code
tac.description: Tracking area code, broadcast in SIB1.

pci.name: Physical Cell Identity
pci.description: The cell's physical identifier (0 to 1007 in NR). E.g. PCI 88 (serving) and PCI 145 (n41 neighbour).

nr-arfcn.name: NR Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number
nr-arfcn.description: Number identifying the carrier frequency. 633180 = 3497.7 MHz (n78); 504990 = 2524.95 MHz (n41).

n78-n41.name: NR bands
n78-n41.description: n78: 3.3–3.8 GHz (TDD). n41: 2.496–2.690 GHz (TDD). Moving between them is an inter-frequency handover.

pdu.name: Protocol Data Unit Session
pdu.description: A data session between the UE and a data network (DNN). What keeps service alive during mobility.

dnn.name: Data Network Name
dnn.description: Name of the session's data network (equivalent to the LTE APN). E.g. internet.novalink.

nssai.name: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information
nssai.description: The list of allowed network slices, sent in the Registration Accept.

drb-srb.name: Data / Signalling Radio Bearer
drb-srb.description: Radio bearers: SRB carries signalling (RRC/NAS); DRB carries user data.

xn-ngap.name: Interfaces between network nodes
xn-ngap.description: Xn connects gNBs; NGAP is the protocol between gNB and AMF. They don't appear in the UE log, hence the request for network traces.

rrc.name: Radio Resource Control
rrc.description: Control protocol between UE and gNB (TS 38.331): connection, measurement, handover and re-establishment.

rrc-states.name: RRC states
rrc-states.description: In IDLE the UE just camps on a cell and reselects; in CONNECTED it has an active connection and mobility is network-controlled (handover).

mib.name: Master Information Block
mib.description: The first system information read from a cell: SFN and whether the cell is barred (cellBarred).

sib.name: System Information Block
sib.description: System information blocks. SIB1 carries PLMN, TAC, cell identity, selection parameters (q-RxLevMin) and the common RACH configuration.

rrcsetup.name: RRC connection setup
rrcsetup.description: The RRCSetupRequest → RRCSetup → RRCSetupComplete sequence that takes the UE to RRC_CONNECTED. In Challenge 3, RRCSetup carries N310/T310.

rrcreconfig.name: RRC reconfiguration
rrcreconfig.description: Message that changes the connection: adds bearers, sends measConfig or, with reconfigurationWithSync, commands a handover.

rwsync.name: Handover command
rwsync.description: RRCReconfiguration IE telling the UE to synchronise with and access the target cell. Starts T304 and stops T310.

rrcreest.name: RRC re-establishment
rrcreest.description: Connection recovery after an RLF: Request → RRCReestablishment → Complete, on a cell that passes the S criterion.

rrcrelease.name: RRC connection release
rrcrelease.description: The network ends the connection and the UE returns to RRC_IDLE. In Challenge 2 it follows each Registration Reject.

ie.name: Information Element
ie.description: A field of a signalling message (e.g. measId, t304, physCellId).

nas.name: Non-Access Stratum
nas.description: Signalling between UE and core (AMF): registration, authentication, security and sessions. Carried inside RRC (DL/ULInformationTransfer).

5gmm.name: 5G Mobility Management
5gmm.description: The NAS sublayer for registration and mobility. A Registration Reject carries a 5GMM cause.

cause3.name: Illegal UE
cause3.description: The network considers the UE/subscription invalid. The UE treats the SIM as invalid for 5GS until power-off or card change.

cause11.name: PLMN not allowed
cause11.description: The subscriber may not use that PLMN. The UE adds it to the forbidden PLMN list and selects another network.

registration.name: 5G registration
registration.description: Request → (Authentication, Security Mode) → Accept → Complete. The 5G equivalent of the LTE Attach.

attach.name: LTE registration
attach.description: The LTE procedure equivalent to 5G registration.

auth.name: 5G-AKA authentication
auth.description: The network sends RAND and AUTN; the SIM verifies the network and returns RES*, proving the subscriber's identity.

ngksi.name: Key Set Identifier
ngksi.description: Identifier of the NAS security key set in use.

nea-nia.name: Ciphering and integrity algorithms
nea-nia.description: AES-128-based algorithms chosen in the Security Mode Command: NEA2 ciphers, NIA2 protects integrity.

rsrp.name: Reference Signal Received Power
rsrp.description: Average received power of the reference signals (in NR, of the SSB), in dBm. The main signal-level measure.

rsrq.name: Reference Signal Received Quality
rsrq.description: Signal quality in dB, accounting for interference and load.

sinr.name: Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio
sinr.description: Signal to (interference + noise) ratio, in dB. At the DUT's late report the serving was at −12 dB.

ssb.name: SS/PBCH Block
ssb.description: A block with PSS, SSS and PBCH (MIB) sent periodically. What the UE measures for RSRP/RSRQ.

serving-neighbour.name: Serving and neighbour cell
serving-neighbour.description: Serving is the cell currently serving the UE; neighbour is the handover candidate.

measconfig.name: Measurement Configuration
measconfig.description: Measurement setup sent in RRCReconfiguration: objects (MO), report criteria, measIds and gaps. MeasConfig #2 is T 0 in Challenge 3.

measid.name: Measurement identifiers
measid.description: A measId links a measurement object (MO, one frequency) to a reportConfig (the event). E.g. measId=2 = n41 + A5.

mr.name: Measurement report
mr.description: UE message stating that an event (A2, A3, A5…) was met. It triggers the network's handover decision.

a2.name: Serving below a threshold
a2.description: Enters when Ms + Hys < Thresh. Tells the network the serving is degrading; in Challenge 3 it triggers MeasConfig #2.

a3.name: Neighbour offset better than serving
a3.description: Enters when Mn + Ofn + Ocn − Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off. Used for intra-frequency handover (scenario 1).

a5.name: Serving worse than Thresh1 and neighbour better than Thresh2
a5.description: Enters when Mp + Hys < Thresh1 and Mn − Hys > Thresh2. In Challenge 3: serving < −107 dBm and neighbour > −99 dBm (−106/−100 with 1 dB hysteresis).

hys.name: Hysteresis
hys.description: Margin that prevents repeated triggers near the threshold. The IE is in 0.5 dB steps: hysteresis = 2 → 1 dB.

ttt.name: Time To Trigger
ttt.description: How long the entering condition must hold before the report is sent (240 ms for the A5 in Challenge 3).

l3filter.name: Layer 3 filtering
l3filter.description: Exponential averaging of measurements: Fn = (1 − a)·Fn−1 + a·Mn. Events are evaluated on the filtered value.

gap.name: Measurement gap
gap.description: Windows in which the UE stops serving the current cell to measure another frequency. MGL = length (6 ms); MGRP = period (40 ms); gapOffset = position.

smtc.name: SSB-based Measurement Timing Configuration
smtc.description: The window in which the UE looks for the measured frequency's SSBs (20 ms period, offset 10 on n41).

ho.name: Handover
ho.description: Change of serving cell in RRC_CONNECTED, commanded by the network. Intra-frequency: same carrier; inter-frequency: another carrier (n78 → n41).

s-criterion.name: Cell selection criterion
s-criterion.description: A cell is suitable only if Srxlev > 0 and Squal > 0 (TS 38.304). Srxlev ≈ measured RSRP − q-RxLevMin.

qrxlevmin.name: Minimum level and quality
qrxlevmin.description: SIB1 thresholds for the S criterion. The level IE is in 2 dBm steps (−59 → −118 dBm). PCI 88 at −120.8 dBm is below it.

cell-reselection.name: Cell selection / reselection
cell-reselection.description: The UE itself picks a suitable cell (in IDLE or during re-establishment). Unlike handover, which the network commands.

rlm.name: Radio Link Monitoring
rlm.description: The UE's continuous link monitoring, comparing estimated BLER with Qout/Qin and producing out-of-sync/in-sync indications.

rlf.name: Radio Link Failure
rlf.description: Failure declared by the UE when the link is lost (e.g. T310 expires). Leads to re-establishment.

bler.name: Block Error Rate
bler.description: Block error rate. In RLM it is that of a hypothetical PDCCH, filtered (OOS_FILT_BLER / IS_FILT_BLER).

qout-qin.name: Out-of-sync and in-sync thresholds
qout-qin.description: Qout = 10 % BLER (out of sync); Qin = 2 % (in sync). In the log: Outsync/Insync_Threshold_q24.

n310.name: RLM counters
n310.description: N310 consecutive out-of-sync indications start T310; N311 in-sync indications stop it. In Challenge 3: N310 = 4, N311 = 1.

t310.name: Radio link failure timer
t310.description: Runs while the link is out of sync. Stops on N311 in-sync or a handover command; on expiry the UE declares RLF (2000 ms in Challenge 3).

t311.name: Re-establishment timer
t311.description: Starts at re-establishment and stops when the UE finds a suitable cell. On expiry the UE goes to IDLE (10000 ms).

t304.name: Handover timer
t304.description: Starts with reconfigurationWithSync and stops when access to the target cell completes. On expiry the handover failed (2000 ms).

rach.name: Random Access (Channel)
rach.description: The random access procedure used to connect, re-establish or enter the handover target cell.

prach.name: Physical Random Access Channel
prach.description: The physical channel on which the UE sends the preamble (Msg1).

msg1-4.name: Random access messages
msg1-4.description: Msg1 = preamble; Msg2 = RAR; Msg3 = the UE's first message (e.g. RRCReestablishmentRequest); Msg4 = contention resolution.

rar.name: Random Access Response
rar.description: The gNB's answer to the preamble (Msg2). If it doesn't arrive within the window, the attempt fails (FAILURE_MSG2_RA_TIMER_EXP).

cfra-cbra.name: Contention-Free / Contention-Based Random Access
cfra-cbra.description: CFRA uses a dedicated preamble sent in the handover command (no contention); CBRA uses a random preamble and needs contention resolution.

rach-params.name: RACH parameters (RACH-ConfigCommon)
rach-params.description: Maximum attempts (6), power increase per attempt (4 dB) and RAR wait window (sl20 = 10 ms at 30 kHz).

target-power.name: Preamble target power
target-power.description: The power at which the gNB expects to receive the 1st preamble (−130 dBm). The target rises by powerRampingStep each attempt.

pathloss.name: Path loss
pathloss.description: Attenuation between gNB and UE, estimated by the UE from RSRP. PRACH Tx = min(Pcmax, target + PL).

pcmax.name: UE maximum power
pcmax.description: The UE's transmit power ceiling (25 dBm in the log). Once the ramp hits it, further attempts gain no power.

ml1.name: Modem Layer 1
ml1.description: The chipset modem's physical layer. ML1 records show measurements, cell searches and RLM.

b959.name: NR5G ML1 RLM Stats
b959.description: RLM statistics: OOS_FILT_BLER and IS_FILT_BLER per evaluation, with the Outsync/Insync thresholds.

b97f.name: NR5G ML1 Searcher Measurement Database Update Ext
b97f.description: Per-cell measurement updates (SFN, RSRP/RSRQ). Where the n41 cadence and level can be seen.

b96d.name: NR5G ML1 Searcher ACQ Config And Response
b96d.description: Cell search and acquisition on a frequency (how many cells, best PCI).

b970.name: NR5G ML1 Searcher Idle S Criteria
b970.description: S criterion result for the evaluated cell (SUCCESS / FAILURE).

b950.name: NR5G ML1 DL Common Config
b950.description: Common downlink configuration of the cell the UE camped on.

b884.name: NR5G MAC UL Physical Channel Power Control
b884.description: Power of each uplink transmission; for PRACH it shows transmit_power, pathloss, mtpl and prach_target_power.

b889.name: NR5G MAC RACH Trigger
b889.description: Start of a RACH procedure and its cause (CONNECTION_REQUEST, RRC_REESTABLISHMENT, HANDOVER).

b88a.name: NR5G MAC RACH Attempt
b88a.description: Result of each RACH attempt (SUCCESS or the failure reason).

q24.name: Q24 fixed point
q24.description: Chipset number format: real value = integer / 2²⁴. E.g. 1677722 → 0.10 (10 %).

bler-cap.name: Logged BLER ceiling
bler-cap.description: The maximum value 0xB959 records (15 %). Readings of 15.0 % mean saturation, not the actual BLER.

sfn.name: System Frame Number
sfn.description: Radio frame number (0 to 1023, 10 ms each). Lets two logs be compared at the same radio instant.

pss-sss.name: Primary / Secondary Synchronization Signal
pss-sss.description: The synchronisation signals the UE detects first; together they give the PCI.

dut.name: Device Under Test
dut.description: The device being certified (Aurora in Challenge 2, Meridian in Challenge 3).

cdut.name: Comparator DUT
cdut.description: An already certified reference device tested under the same conditions (Boreal in Challenge 2, Solstice in Challenge 3).

kpi.name: Key Performance Indicator
kpi.description: An indicator used to judge the test (e.g. handover without RLF, or time to report).

3gpp-ts.name: 3GPP technical specifications
3gpp-ts.description: TS 38.331 (RRC), TS 38.304 (IDLE cell selection), TS 38.133 (RRM requirements), TS 38.533 (RRM conformance tests), TS 24.501 (5G NAS).

fisher.name: Comparing proportions in small samples
fisher.description: Computes the chance of a result as extreme as 3/3 × 0/3 by chance: p = 0.10 two-sided, which is not significant at 5 %.

ci.name: Exact confidence interval
ci.description: A plausible range for a true rate. With 3 of 3, the DUT's RLF rate could be anywhere from 29 % to 100 %.

earfcn.name: E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number
earfcn.description: Number identifying the LTE carrier. In Challenge 4, EARFCN 1575 = 1842.5 MHz in Band 3.

paging.name: Paging
paging.description: Network notice to an idle UE that there is traffic for it. On an MT call the UE answers with RRC Setup (establishmentCause mt-Access).

ims.name: IP Multimedia Subsystem
ims.description: Core that provides voice and messaging over IP (VoLTE, VoNR) using SIP. The UE must be registered with IMS to make or receive calls.

cscf.name: Proxy / Serving Call Session Control Function
cscf.description: IMS SIP servers. The P-CSCF is the UE's first point of contact; the S-CSCF authenticates registration and controls sessions.

sip.name: Session Initiation Protocol
sip.description: IMS signalling protocol (RFC 3261): REGISTER, INVITE, UPDATE, BYE. Responses are numbered: 1xx provisional, 2xx success, 4xx client error.

sip-register.name: SIP registration
sip-register.description: UE request to register with IMS. The first one carries no credentials; the network answers 401 with a challenge and the UE repeats the REGISTER with an Authorization.

sip-401.name: Authentication challenge
sip-401.description: Normal response to the first REGISTER: it carries the WWW-Authenticate with the nonce the UE must use on the next attempt. It is not a failure.

sip-403.name: Registration refused
sip-403.description: The network refuses the credential presented. In Challenge 4 the Warning: 399 header gives the reason: "nonce does not match latest challenge".

digest.name: Digest authentication (MD5)
digest.description: The server sends a nonce (one-time value) in the 401; the UE computes the response from the password and that nonce. Using an old nonce invalidates the response. The Challenge 4 bench uses Digest MD5 instead of IMS-AKA.

sdp.name: Session Description Protocol
sdp.description: Body of SIP messages that describes the media: port, codecs and payload types. One side offers, the other answers, as defined in RFC 3264.

payload-type.name: Codec number in RTP
payload-type.description: Voice codecs use dynamic numbers (96–127) defined in the SDP by a=rtpmap lines (e.g. a=rtpmap:97 AMR/8000). Within a session a number must not change codec (RFC 3264 §8.3.2).

evs.name: Enhanced Voice Services
evs.description: 3GPP voice codec with bandwidth up to super-wideband (SWB), from 5.9 to 128 kbps. Preferred on VoNR.

amr.name: Adaptive Multi-Rate
amr.description: 3GPP voice codecs: AMR (narrowband, 8 kHz, up to 12.2 kbps) and AMR-WB (wideband, 16 kHz). An EVS decoder cannot understand AMR, and vice versa.

telephone-event.name: DTMF over RTP
telephone-event.description: Payload type used to carry keypad tones (DTMF) inside the RTP stream (RFC 4733).

prack.name: Reliable provisional response
prack.description: The 183 Session Progress carries the SDP answer before the call is answered; the PRACK confirms it arrived (RFC 3262).

precondition.name: QoS preconditions
precondition.description: The call only rings once both sides have the voice bearer reserved. The UPDATE with a=curr:qos local sendrecv announces that local QoS is ready (RFC 3312).

qci1.name: Conversational voice bearer
qci1.description: QoS class with guaranteed bit rate (GBR) for voice: QCI 1 dedicated bearer on LTE, 5QI 1 flow on 5G. In Challenge 4, 53 kbps GBR.

rtp.name: Real-time Transport Protocol
rtp.description: RTP carries the encoded voice frames; RTCP reports statistics. Normal TX/RX counters show the packets arrive, not that the audio is correct.

vocoder.name: Voice encoder / decoder
vocoder.description: Component that turns voice into codec frames and back. It must use the codec the SDP binds to the received payload type.

vonr-volte.name: Voice over NR / Voice over LTE
vonr-volte.description: Voice calls over IMS in 5G SA and LTE, respectively.

mo-mt.name: Mobile Originated / Mobile Terminated
mo-mt.description: Call placed by the device (MO) or received by it (MT).

vds.name: Voice domain selection
vds.description: UE logic that decides how voice is carried: IMS (VoNR/VoLTE), EPS fallback or CS. Without IMS registration in 5G SA it may conclude there is no voice.

toggle-power.name: Partial vs full restart
toggle-power.description: An airplane mode toggle restarts the radio and the IMS client but may keep state in memory (such as a nonce cache). A power cycle restarts the whole device and clears that state.
